contentPattern.structure: full-bleed dark background graphic + single left-aligned white heading (no panel, no CTA, no stats)

suitableFor: section / menu landing page heros with a full-bleed background graphic and a plain heading
dark full-bleed image heros with a single left-aligned white headline and no call-to-action
top-of-page banners that lead a link/tile grid
notSuitableFor: heros with a background video (use hero-video / hero-stats)
dark full-bleed video heros with an overlaid stats strip + CTA (use hero-stats)
light two-column text-beside-media heros with a stats bar (use hero-impact)
light full-bleed photo heros with a translucent left panel and a download CTA (use hero-banner)
